title: How to Tailor Your Resume to Any Job (Using One Master Resume)
description:
-----------------------------------------------------
Tailoring your resume for every job application doesn't mean starting from scratch each time. In Teal, you build one master resume — your full career history — then curate the right bullets, order, and format for each role you apply to.

 Sign up for your free Teal account & get your resume job-ready:

In this video, learn how to:
 Keep your full work history in one place
 Select the bullets that match the job, deselect the rest
 Reorder bullets to lead with what the role values most
 Switch between reverse chronological and functional resume formats
 Adjust date formats and section order per application

transcript: [music] >> In Teal's resume builder, you have full control over how your content is ordered and displayed. So, every resume you send is curated to the job. Teal works from a master resume. Your full work history lives in one place. You simply select or deselect items when curating for a specific role. In this example, the job I'm applying to emphasizes leadership. So, I'll find the relevant bullet in my marketing director experience and check it on. The resume preview on the right updates immediately. You can also reorder bullets by dragging and dropping. Since leadership is the priority here, I'll drag that bullet to the top so it leads. Open the display settings menu, the three-dot icon in the top right of any section, for additional layout controls. From here, you can edit companies and positions and choose how your experience is sorted. By default, it's reverse chronological. Switch to manual to drag and drop entire companies into whatever order works best. Useful if you want a more functional resume format. This menu also controls your date format. Show years only, month and year, or other options, whatever fits the role. From here, you can also jump into design mode to customize the overall look and feel of your resume. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
